items.mainDefect: Direct indexing into dcg_to_slow_conditions can raise KeyError when a buffered condition group is missing.

secondary.defect: Direct indexing into workflows_to_envs can raise KeyError when a workflow_id is missing.

items.mainDefect: Raw error titles and messages are sent to Seer without scrubbing sensitive information.

secondary.defect: Error content sent to Seer has no length limit.

items.mainDefect: The single-error test does not cover pairing errors when multiple IDs include a missing nodestore entry.

secondary.defect: Zipping error_ids with events.values() can associate event data with the wrong error ID when nodestore entries are missing.

items.mainDefect: Removing Visualize.yAxes breaks existing consumers unless a compatibility getter is retained or callers are migrated.

secondary.defect: The changed Visualize.fromJSON contract breaks compatibility with the old shape and callers expecting a single object instead of an array.
